text.text: Plan the work and see its price. Run specialist agents. Read a memo where every claim has a source. Keep it current as the facts change.
Price every agent before it starts
A grade and a source on every claim
New facts rewrite only what they touch
No run starts without a plan you have seen. The coordinator drafts it in seconds: the sequence of agents, what each one will cost, what it s
Estimated from the agent’s own profile and the list prices of the providers you connected.
Pick Economy, Balanced or Frontier, or set a tier agent by agent.
Change a model, watch the total move.
If a run would cross your budget, it stops and delivers what exists, with a list of what is missing.
After the run, each agent shows its drift, and its profile updates itself.
Frontier tier where the verdict is made, standard and light elsewhere.
A new revenue export later: rebuild 2 of 8 for
Public sources the agents fetch, and whatever you ticked when you created the target: a deck, a website, filed accounts.
Management accounts, a revenue export of 18 months or more, customer interviews, access to the product. Without them the plan says which sec
Analyst reports, references, a penetration test. Add them now or when they arrive: new evidence only rebuilds what it touches.
The plan is saved with the target. , or edit the steering note to tell the coordinator what to weigh. Every plan is stored as the first vers
Save it and run it later
One agent per question, started in the order the method requires and in parallel wherever it allows. You watch one line per agent, and open
The run pauses here until you approve.
Every claim has a source id. Nothing unsourced is written, unless flagged C.
Runs on a different model family than the writers.
The coordinator plans, it does not write
It reads the target and your thesis, picks the route, and asks one question when the answer changes the plan.
Each agent in its own sandbox
A clean context, the evidence mounted read-only, and a short list of hosts it may reach. No agent sees another’s scratch work.
A run waits at a gate for as long as you need. It survives restarts, and picks up exactly where it stopped.
If one agent fails, its dependents wait and the rest continue. You get a partial memo with a clear list of what is missing.
Verdict first, then a section per question, each with a confidence and a source on every claim. The work behind a section is one click away.
Illustrative composite. Not a real company.
Retention flattens after the ninth month.
Founders hold a majority and the digital leader reports to the CEO.
The uptime guarantee is claimed but missing from the customer contract.
Demand is moving from point tools to platforms in the mid-market.
Retention flattens after month nine, graded A because the source is the data room export
High, Medium or Low, computed from the mix of A, B and C claims: (A + half of B) over all claims. High at 0.7 or more, Medium at 0.45.
Change a sentence in place. It is saved as a steering note for the next rebuild, and the new version is marked as human-edited.
Export to PDF, Google Doc or Notion, with the evidence appendix. Every export carries the workspace, the date and “evidence-graded analysis,
Drop a file, see exactly what it touches
Drop files, links or pasted text. Each one is classified, graded and tagged.
Illustrative. Drop the file to see what happens.
Every artifact records what it was built from. When a file arrives, the platform computes the sections that went stale, shows why, and price
Files, links and pasted text are stored, read, classified, graded and tagged to the sections they touch.
Public, target-confidential and fund-internal. The plan shows which provider will read which class, before launch.
Turn an item in the appendix into a request with an upload link that needs no account. You approve what lands.
Loyal and churned customers, competitor founders and teams: each call becomes a source and upgrades the claims it touches. Upload it, or boo
A deck can contain instructions. Agents treat it as data, and have no tool that sends anything out.
Term sheets, partner notes and your own view of a founder belong in a vault, not in a prompt. It is hosted by us and encrypted in your brows
The key comes from your passphrase and stays with you. We store only ciphertext. Lose the passphrase and the recovery code, and the vault is
A note reaches a run only when you share it for that target. The read is logged.
Agents are locked out by default.
Notes with links between them. Import an Obsidian vault, export a zip that Obsidian opens unchanged.
A note can link a target, a source or a section, and shows up as a backlink in its lineage.
A plugin in your vault pairs with a one-time code and shares only the notes you mark. The rest stays on your side, and we hold no key to it.
Another vault? . The requests we count decide what we connect next.
My read: honest on the numbers, vague on the roadmap. Backchannel before IC.

A diligence is not done by agents alone, nor by people alone. TheDiligence is the place where they work on the same file. Agents plan, read
The coordinator drafts the plan and its price.
You approve the plan, or edit the steering note to tell it what to weigh.
Specialist agents run, in parallel wherever the method allows, each in its own sandbox.
A gate opens before the verdict, with what was found and what is still doubtful.
You answer the gate, and add what only people can get: an interview, an export, a view.
Partners comment on a section. A comment can become a steering note for the agents.
Only the sections touched by the new evidence are rebuilt, and priced before you approve.
Your own agents and personal assistants take part through MCP (Next): start a plan, read a memo, add evidence or answer a gate.
Home is an inbox, and so is your email
What needs you, what is running, what was delivered, across every target. Answer a gate with one click, in the app or from the notification
An MCP interface (Next) lets the agents and assistants you already use take part in the work. They propose and fetch. A person still opens e
The data still needed becomes an email draft and an upload link. Statuses: requested, received, ingested. A delta run follows.
The verdict held or moved, which sections were rewritten and because of which evidence, what it cost. Mark it reviewed.
A fund or an advisor holds many targets, each with a deal stage: screening, IC, passed, invested. Roles: owner, analyst, viewer.
Jump to a target, a section or a source from the command palette. Open the next item that needs you with one shortcut.
The platform never resells a model. You connect your own provider account by approving access on its own screen. The usage lands in your acc
The method runs unchanged on the provider you connected.
Writers on the provider you pick.
It checks the writers with no tools, cheaply, against a different set of blind spots.
Agents hold a run token. A broker uses your authorised connection and enforces your cap.
A pasted key is the last resort, and it is encrypted.
Bedrock, Vertex, Azure, xAI and more
Your provider is not on the list? Tell us on the . The requests we count decide what comes next. When several writer models can run in one m
Name a company. The coordinator drafts the plan and the price. You decide whether to run it.
Skilled agents, orchestrated for evidence. Built by operator-investors, for operator-investors.
